join_path_requirements.name: shipments_to_orders
join_path_requirements.purpose: Supports shipment analysis using order attributes.

join_path_requirements.name: inventory_to_warehouses
join_path_requirements.purpose: Supports warehouse inventory and replenishment analysis.

join_path_requirements.name: orders_to_warehouses_left
join_path_requirements.purpose: Supports orders with NULL or declared-orphan warehouse assignments.

join_path_requirements.name: orders_to_warehouses_inner_subset
join_path_requirements.purpose: Confirms valid warehouse assignments remain available.

join_path_requirements.name: orders_to_shipments_to_carriers
join_path_requirements.purpose: Supports the required three-table Order-to-Shipment-to-Carrier path.

date_rules: All normal relative dates use config/generation/base.json:reference_today and never the wall clock.
A shipment ship_date cannot precede its order_date.
A delivery_date requires ship_date and cannot precede it.
Shipment status determines whether ship_date and delivery_date are required or null.
Orders and shipments must preserve created_at chronology.
Boundary-date scenarios update dependent order and shipment dates together.
decimal_rules: Stored decimal values use their configured precision and exactly two fractional digits.
All rounding uses ROUND_HALF_UP and calculations round once at the final output scale.
Order totals are positive and populated carrier rates and shipment costs are non-negative.
Binary floating-point arithmetic is prohibited for contract values.
currency_rules: carriers.currency_code, orders.currency_code, and shipments.currency_code must equal USD.
Logistics has no FX conversion path.
imperfection_rules: Warehouse NULL and declared-orphan positions are deterministic and disjoint.
Warehouse NULLs equal the shared null percentage of base orders.
Declared warehouse orphans equal 1.0 percent of base orders and use the configured namespace formula.
Near-duplicate shipments preserve business keys, receive new primary keys, and vary an approved field.
Near-duplicate counts use the base shipment count, not the final row count.
Order amount outliers remain positive fixed-scale USD values.
Boundary shipment sources are protected from duplicate selection.
consistency_rules: Every physical foreign key must reference an existing parent row.
Only orders.warehouse_id may contain declared orphan values.
The clean stage contains only valid populated warehouse assignments.
At least one order remains without shipments.
Shipped and Delivered orders have shipment evidence; Returned orders retain shipment history.
At least one order uses multiple carriers and at least one carrier serves multiple orders.
Clean shipment business keys are unique before duplicate injection.
Inventory warehouse and SKU pairs are logically unique.
Inventory quantities and populated reorder points are non-negative.
Inventory created_at is not after last_updated_at.
All Logistics currency values are USD.
Only shipments may gain rows during imperfection injection.
release_validation_rules: Full release output is immutable after manifest creation.
Every release CSV header must match schemas/logistics/logistics_csv_header_spec.md.
Reproducibility requires byte-identical CSV hashes from a clean regeneration.
